content: The end of all knowledge is spiritual freedom, and the way to it is moral purification.
author: Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan
explanation: Information is not wisdom, and intellect alone cannot free the human spirit. True knowledge culminates in experiential spiritual emancipation grounded in moral integrity.
practicalInsight: Examine the ultimate purpose behind your current learning and career strivings. Ensure it aims at inner freedom and ethical service.
reflectionPrompt: Is my pursuit of knowledge inflating my ego or purifying my character?
